description: This Java test class, ModuleFactoryTest, contains unit tests for the ModuleFactory class within the openmrs-core project. It verifies module loading, reloading, dependency management, and error handling behaviors in the OpenMRS module framework.

classes.name: ModuleFactoryTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing functionalities of ModuleFactory, including loading, starting, and dependency handling of modules.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Sets up the test environment by shutting down existing modules and initializing with a specific module loaded.

methods.name: cleanUp
methods.description: Performs cleanup after all tests, shutting down modules to prevent interference.

methods.name: loadModule
methods.description: Helper method to load a module from a specified resource location with optional replacement.

methods.name: getModuleFiles
methods.description: Helper method to retrieve a list of module files for batch loading during tests.
